character: Rollercoaster Portuguese circuit with dramatic elevation change and multiple blind crests. Turn 1 (Primeira) is a tight downshift zone, and Turn 5 (Torre Vip) at the bottom of the biggest drop is the tightest corner on the lap.
sources: https://driver61.com/circuit-guide/portimao/ — Primeira/Turn 4 blind crest/Torre Vip naming verified

corners.name: Primeira
corners.technique: Heavy downshift under braking, late apex
corners.trap: Misjudging the braking distance from the very high approach speed

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.type: fast corner over a blind crest
corners.technique: Commit through the crest, be ready for the car to go light and possibly oversteer on landing
corners.trap: Lifting or correcting as the car unloads over the blind crest

corners.name: Torre Vip
corners.type: tightest corner on the circuit, a 160-degree left-hander (Turn 5) after a long downhill braking zone
corners.technique: Brake hard on the downhill approach, late apex, patient throttle on exit
corners.trap: Braking too early wastes the downhill advantage; too late and you miss the apex entirely

corners.name: Turn 15
corners.type: final, sweeping corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the run to the line
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
